# standardize_timeseries { #wass2s.standardize_timeseries }

```python
standardize_timeseries(ds, clim_year_start=None, clim_year_end=None)
```

Standardize a dataset over a specified climatology period.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name            | Type                               | Description                                                              | Default    |
|-----------------|------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| ds              | xarray.Dataset or xarray.DataArray | Input dataset or data array to standardize.                              | _required_ |
| clim_year_start | int                                | Start year of the climatology period. If None, uses the full time range. | `None`     |
| clim_year_end   | int                                | End year of the climatology period. If None, uses the full time range.   | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                               | Description                                    |
|--------|------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------|
|        | xarray.Dataset or xarray.DataArray | Standardized dataset or data array (z-scores). |

## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

Standardization is performed as (ds - mean) / std, where mean and std are
computed over the specified climatology period or the entire time dimension.
